Priya (PM): WIP prototype in Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abc123 12 — focusing on the Prompt Sets & Evals approval flow + scorecard density. Need quick takes on copy, keyboard behavior, and audit fields before we freeze for dev.
Jordan (Eng): Backend note: heavy diffs need to be lazy-loaded. Suggest rendering lightweight metadata first (lines changed, tokens added) and a 'Download snapshot' link for full HTML. Also dedupe runs by prompt-hash to avoid duplicate thumbnails.
Elliot (Design): Visually the scorecard stacks too much on mobile. Propose a condensed row mode: metric name, value (2 decimals), tiny trend sparkline, and an icon for pass/fail. Replace color-only state with icon + color for colorblind support.
Marta (QA): QA requirements: snapshot ids must be deterministic and pin-able. Tests should be able to request a specific snapshot_id to reproduce. The diff view must show raw model output + reference side-by-side for failing examples.
InfraBot: Storage policy reminder: default retention for evaluation snapshots is 90 days for trial/orgs. Enterprise plans can enable extended retention. Snapshots stored at s3://redwood-evals/<org>/<snapshot_id>.
Priya (PM): Copy tweak: change primary CTA from "Approve" to "Approve snapshot" and secondary to "Request changes". Add optional "Rationale" textarea on approve so reviewers can leave a quick note.
Jordan (Eng): Keyboard behavior: modal must trap focus. Esc closes unless unsaved rationale present (confirm). Enter should activate primary ONLY when textarea not focused. Add aria-live region for diff load progress.
Elliot (Design): A11y nit: current green badge contrast with white text is borderline on small displays. Also screen reader text should read "Pass - meets threshold" instead of just "Pass". Use aria-labels for compound badges.
Marta (QA): Regression policy suggestion: if overall score drops >5% vs baseline, mark run as 'auto-flag' and require two approvers. Also exportable audit CSV is mandatory: e.g., header: snapshot_id,approved_by,role,timestamp,approval_note,baseline_hash
Priya (PM): Approval workflow idea: allow "Approve with comment" which records snapshot version, reviewer role, and an immutable permalink. Add a small timeline entry on the prompt-set page showing approval history. Legal asked for exportable audit log and retention details.
Jordan (Eng): Implementation bits: snapshot immutability enforced at storage layer; signed URLs for blobs with TTL default 7 days. We'll add a background job to precompute thumbnail diffs and small inline patch summaries to speed UX.
DesignBot: Automated check: "Yield" tokens metric label low contrast detected. Recommend darker token color (#2b3b4a) or increased font weight.
Elliot (Design): Interaction detail: hovering a diff thumbnail shows a micro-preview; keyboard users can focus thumbnails with Tab and use ArrowLeft/ArrowRight to move between runs. Visible focus ring required (not just color).
Marta (QA): For smoke tests: I'll create a tiny regression suite that runs on PR merges and validates: 1) audit CSV generation, 2) snapshot download integrity, 3) approval flow prevents single-approver bypass when rule applies.
Priya (PM): Notifications: on approval send a threaded message to prompt-owners and post to #eval-audit channel. Enterprise option: webhook with payload including snapshot_id, reviewer, role, score_delta.
Jordan (Eng): API contract sketch: POST /api/v1/evals/{snapshot_id}/approve { reviewer, role, note, action } -> returns audit_entry_id. Audit entry stores snapshot_url, immutable snapshot_hash.
Elliot (Design): I'll upload two frames tonight: compact table for >8 metrics and stacked card for fewer metrics. Will annotate keyboard flows and ARIA labels in the figma notes.
Marta (QA): One more: export CSV must include human-readable prompt-set version string so auditors can map to git-like messages.
Priya (PM): Action items: Elliot - updated frames + ARIA labels (Mon). Jordan - API + signed urls + dedupe (Mon). Marta - regression smoke & CSV schema (Tue). Legal/ops: decide retention & export policy. If no objections I'll add this to next sprint scope. :thumbsup:
